disease_recommendations.(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo: Avoid sudden head movements. Perform Epley maneuver exercises as directed by a healthcare provider. Sleep with head elevated. Avoid positions that trigger vertigo. Consult a neurologist for persistent symptoms.
disease_recommendations.AIDS: Seek immediate medical care from an infectious disease specialist. Start antiretroviral therapy (ART) as prescribed. Practice safe sex and avoid sharing needles. Maintain regular medical checkups. Follow a healthy diet and lifestyle to support immune function.
disease_recommendations.Acne: Maintain a gentle skincare routine with non-comedogenic products. Avoid picking or squeezing pimples. Consider over-the-counter treatments with benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid. Consult a dermatologist for severe or persistent acne. Keep skin clean and avoid excessive washing.
disease_recommendations.Alcoholic hepatitis: Immediately stop alcohol consumption. Seek medical attention from a hepatologist. Follow a balanced diet and avoid fatty foods. Take prescribed medications as directed. Consider liver function monitoring and support groups for alcohol cessation.
disease_recommendations.Allergy: Identify and avoid allergens. Use antihistamines as recommended by a doctor. Consider allergy testing to identify specific triggers. Keep an epinephrine auto-injector if severe reactions occur. Consult an allergist for long-term management strategies.
disease_recommendations.Arthritis: Maintain regular low-impact exercise like swimming or walking. Apply heat or cold therapy to affected joints. Take anti-inflammatory medications as prescribed. Maintain a healthy weight to reduce joint stress. Consult a rheumatologist for specialized treatment.
disease_recommendations.Bronchial Asthma: Use prescribed inhalers as directed. Identify and avoid asthma triggers. Keep a rescue inhaler accessible at all times. Monitor peak flow readings regularly. Create an asthma action plan with your healthcare provider.
disease_recommendations.Cervical spondylosis: Practice good posture and ergonomics. Perform neck exercises and stretches as recommended. Use a supportive pillow while sleeping. Apply heat or cold therapy. Consult a physical therapist or orthopedic specialist for treatment.
disease_recommendations.Chicken pox: Rest and stay hydrated. Avoid scratching to prevent infection and scarring. Use calamine lotion or oatmeal baths for itching. Keep isolated until all blisters have crusted. Consult a doctor, especially for children or if complications arise.
disease_recommendations.Chronic cholestasis: Follow a low-fat diet. Take prescribed medications to manage symptoms. Avoid alcohol completely. Monitor liver function regularly. Consult a gastroenterologist or hepatologist for specialized care.
disease_recommendations.Common Cold: Rest and stay hydrated. Use over-the-counter cold medications for symptom relief. Gargle with warm salt water for sore throat. Use a humidifier to ease congestion. Most colds resolve within 7-10 days without medical intervention.
disease_recommendations.Dengue: Rest and maintain adequate fluid intake. Monitor for warning signs like severe abdominal pain or bleeding. Avoid aspirin and NSAIDs. Seek immediate medical attention if symptoms worsen. Follow up with healthcare provider for monitoring.
disease_recommendations.Diabetes: Monitor blood sugar levels regularly. Follow a balanced diet with controlled carbohydrate intake. Take medications or insulin as prescribed. Engage in regular physical activity. Schedule regular checkups with an endocrinologist.
disease_recommendations.Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles): Increase fiber intake and stay hydrated. Avoid straining during bowel movements. Use over-the-counter treatments like witch hazel or hydrocortisone cream. Take warm sitz baths. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.
disease_recommendations.Drug Reaction: Stop taking the medication immediately if safe to do so. Seek medical attention, especially for severe reactions. Keep a record of the medication and reaction. Inform all healthcare providers about drug allergies. Consider carrying a medical alert card.
disease_recommendations.Fungal infection: Keep affected areas clean and dry. Use antifungal medications as prescribed. Avoid sharing personal items like towels or shoes. Wear breathable clothing. Complete the full course of treatment even if symptoms improve.
disease_recommendations.GERD: Eat smaller, more frequent meals. Avoid trigger foods like spicy, fatty, or acidic foods. Avoid lying down immediately after eating. Elevate the head of your bed. Take prescribed medications like antacids or proton pump inhibitors.
disease_recommendations.Gastroenteritis: Stay hydrated with water, oral rehydration solutions, or clear broths. Rest and avoid solid foods initially. Gradually reintroduce bland foods. Practice good hand hygiene to prevent spread. Seek medical attention if dehydration occurs or symptoms persist.
disease_recommendations.Heart attack: Seek immediate emergency medical care (call 911). Chew aspirin if not allergic and recommended by emergency services. Stay calm and rest while waiting for help. Do not drive yourself to the hospital. Follow cardiac rehabilitation program after treatment.
disease_recommendations.Hepatitis B: Seek medical care from a hepatologist or infectious disease specialist. Get vaccinated if not already immune. Avoid alcohol and follow a liver-friendly diet. Take antiviral medications as prescribed. Practice safe sex and avoid sharing needles.
disease_recommendations.Hepatitis C: Consult a hepatologist for treatment options. Modern antiviral treatments can cure most cases. Avoid alcohol completely. Get vaccinated for Hepatitis A and B. Practice safe sex and avoid sharing needles.
disease_recommendations.Hepatitis D: Seek specialized care from a hepatologist. Treatment focuses on managing Hepatitis B co-infection. Avoid alcohol completely. Follow a liver-friendly diet. Monitor liver function regularly.
disease_recommendations.Hepatitis E: Rest and maintain adequate hydration. Most cases resolve on their own. Avoid alcohol during recovery. Practice good hygiene and food safety. Seek medical attention if symptoms are severe or persistent.
disease_recommendations.Hypertension: Monitor blood pressure regularly. Follow a low-sodium diet (DASH diet). Engage in regular physical activity. Take prescribed medications consistently. Limit alcohol and avoid smoking.
disease_recommendations.Hyperthyroidism: Take prescribed antithyroid medications as directed. Avoid iodine-rich foods if recommended. Monitor thyroid function regularly. Consult an endocrinologist for specialized care. Manage stress and maintain a balanced diet.
disease_recommendations.Hypoglycemia: Consume fast-acting carbohydrates immediately (glucose tablets, juice, or candy). Follow with a protein snack. Monitor blood sugar levels regularly. Eat regular meals and snacks. Consult a doctor to identify and treat underlying causes.
disease_recommendations.Hypothyroidism: Take thyroid hormone replacement medication as prescribed. Take medication on an empty stomach. Monitor thyroid function regularly. Follow up with an endocrinologist. Maintain a balanced diet with adequate iodine.
disease_recommendations.Impetigo: Keep affected areas clean and dry. Use prescribed antibiotic ointments or oral antibiotics. Avoid scratching to prevent spread. Wash hands frequently. Isolate from others until treatment has started and lesions are healing.
disease_recommendations.Jaundice: Seek medical attention to identify underlying cause. Follow treatment for the specific condition causing jaundice. Avoid alcohol. Maintain a balanced diet. Monitor liver function as directed by healthcare provider.
disease_recommendations.Malaria: Seek immediate medical attention for diagnosis and treatment. Take antimalarial medications as prescribed. Rest and stay hydrated. Use mosquito nets and repellents to prevent further exposure. Complete the full course of treatment.
disease_recommendations.Migraine: Rest in a dark, quiet room during attacks. Identify and avoid triggers (foods, stress, hormonal changes). Use prescribed medications for acute attacks and prevention. Apply cold compresses to head or neck. Keep a migraine diary to track patterns.
disease_recommendations.Osteoarthristis: Maintain regular low-impact exercise. Use assistive devices if needed. Apply heat or cold therapy. Take pain medications as prescribed. Consider physical therapy for joint strengthening and mobility.
disease_recommendations.Paralysis (brain hemorrhage): Seek immediate emergency medical care. Follow rehabilitation program with physical and occupational therapists. Take medications as prescribed to prevent complications. Work with healthcare team for recovery. Support from family and caregivers is crucial.
disease_recommendations.Peptic ulcer diseae: Take prescribed medications (proton pump inhibitors, antibiotics if H. pylori present). Avoid NSAIDs and aspirin. Follow a bland diet initially, then gradually return to normal. Avoid smoking and limit alcohol. Manage stress levels.
disease_recommendations.Pneumonia: Rest and maintain adequate hydration. Take prescribed antibiotics or antiviral medications as directed. Use a humidifier to ease breathing. Monitor symptoms and seek immediate care if breathing difficulties worsen. Complete the full course of treatment.
disease_recommendations.Psoriasis: Moisturize skin regularly. Use prescribed topical treatments or medications. Avoid triggers like stress, infections, or skin injuries. Consider phototherapy if recommended. Consult a dermatologist for severe cases.
disease_recommendations.Tuberculosis: Take prescribed anti-TB medications exactly as directed for the full course (usually 6-9 months). Complete treatment even if symptoms improve. Isolate from others until no longer contagious. Follow up regularly with healthcare provider. Practice good respiratory hygiene.
disease_recommendations.Typhoid: Seek medical attention for antibiotic treatment. Rest and maintain adequate hydration. Follow a soft, easily digestible diet. Practice good hygiene to prevent spread. Complete the full course of antibiotics.
disease_recommendations.Urinary tract infection: Drink plenty of water to flush bacteria. Take prescribed antibiotics as directed. Complete the full course of treatment. Urinate frequently and avoid holding urine. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or recur frequently.
disease_recommendations.Varicose veins: Elevate legs when resting. Wear compression stockings as recommended. Engage in regular exercise to improve circulation. Avoid prolonged standing or sitting. Consult a vascular specialist for severe cases or if complications arise.
disease_recommendations.hepatitis A: Rest and maintain adequate hydration. Most cases resolve on their own within a few weeks. Practice good hygiene to prevent spread. Avoid alcohol during recovery. Get vaccinated if not already immune.
disease_recommendations.tiểu đường: Please consult a healthcare provider for proper diagnosis and treatment.
